name: plan-seo-site
description: Plan a product site's SEO infrastructure and keyword-driven landing pages with 哥飞's method: one domain + one-level semantic subdirectory + one-page-one-keyword, task-words not attribute-words, keyword KD / referring-domain budget, content i18n & hreflang/canonical/skeleton checks, trailing-slash & main-domain normalization, and Search Console indexing verification.
descriptionZh: 用哥飞方法论规划产品站的 SEO 基建与按关键词驱动的落地页：一个域名 + 一级语义子目录 + 一页一词，任务词而非属性词，选词 KD/引用域预算，内容国际化与 hreflang/canonical 骨架核查，尾斜杠与主域规范化，以及搜索控制台收录验收。
